summary.en: Collapse or Boss Chase (zs_bosschase) is a special Zombie Scenario "raid" map introduced in Zombie Scenario: Season 5.

story.en:
Collapse or Boss Chase (zs_bosschase) is a special Zombie Scenario "raid" map introduced in Zombie Scenario: Season 5.

## Overview

Players are able to battle against several bosses from previous seasons. They are Oberon, Dione, Revenant, Fallen Titan, Neid and Zavist, Siege Type Phobos and Frozen Terror, albeit as mini-bosses the last two.

## Official description

Using the data collected from a secret laboratory, a secret Intelligence was founded to revive the bosses for simulation experiment.

Locate the place and defeat all the bosses before they have a chance to escape. Destroy the lab!

## Goal

* Find and eliminate all the bosses.

## Release date

* South Korea: 17 September 2015.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 22 September 2015.
 * China: 23 September 2015.
 * Japan: 30 September 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 18 December 2015.
 * Indonesia: 3 February 2016.
 * Vietnam: 26 May 2016.

## Transcripts

* 1) Can you hear me? Thanks God if you are safe! Let’s start the mission briefing.
 * 2) Your mission is to launch an attack on the lab and eliminate all zombies.
 * 3) All the bosses are in recreated areas which mimic their original locations where they first appeared. Thry are called as "testing area".
 * 4) I believe the path to the next one will appear when you defeat the boss in the current area.
 * 5) The security is tight, so I can’t keep an eye on where you are located or where you’ll be heading next.
 * 6) So be cautious and complete the mission!
 * 7) The door to the next stage is open! Move!

## Trivia

* This map introduces a new gameplay of Scenario: Raid. The main goal is similar to Annihilation style, eliminate all the bosses.
 * The differences are, instead of defeating each boss in each round, the game only consists one round, and players must find the arenas to defeat the bosses. In other words, this gameplay is a combination of Pursuit style and Annihilation style.
 * This map is a mixture of each boss arena, from Dead End, Toxicity, Decoy, Contact and Envy Mask. Note that the selection is random, the game can start at any 1 of them.
 * Defeating bosses in this map does not increase the counter of [Phobos Slayer], [Oberon Slayer], [Dione Pursuer], [Firefighter], [Titan Attacker] and [Detective] medals.
 * Players will face seperately Siege Type Phobos and Frozen Terror in a small area as mini-bosses that have to be defeated in order to proceed to the next area as they will block the way during breakthrough. Their behavior is akin to previous chapters - lower healthpoints and basic attacks, however, only Frozen Terror will be launching basic attacks.
 * If Round Retry is used, the game will not be restarted but continue as is currently, meaning that health points will not be affected.
 * This is the second time where players are able to kill Dione after in Zombie Giant.

story.en:
* 1) Jim and Gerrard finally arrive at the lab where they will deliver samples.
 * 2) As soon as the sample is delivered to the research center that seems to be hidden in the polar region and is about to withdraw, a large number of zombies appear and engage in combat.
 * 3) Anomalies are witnessed, such as zombies showing interest in samples, and as the zombies attack intensify, a rescue helicopter is called to escape, but fails.
 * 4) While searching the research center to hold the client accountable, he follows a mysterious voice and engages in a fierce battle with a huge infectious organism he encounters.
 * 5) CF. It turned out that part of the Rex virus was left behind in a sample Gerrard was carrying. Why zombies react to the Rex virus is still being studied.

If you do get eaten, you should quickly install a C4 on Savaging Glutney's stomach and pray that you can escape. In addition, the skin of the Glutonny cannot be damaged by standard firepower, so the weak point on the top of the body must be attacked.

summary.en: Convoy or Rescue: Isolated City is a side story of Zombie Scenario: Season 9.

story.en:
* Zombie Scenario Season 9 Side Story

While many heroes, including Soi, Jennifer, and David Black, were working to stop Douglas's ambitions, the zombies that Douglas had sent to the surface were spreading not only to the Aegis Research Institute but also all over the world, invading numerous cities. The civilian survivors in the attacked city continued their desperate struggle for survival, using various items, equipment, and furniture, endlessly waiting for relief aid that might arrive at any moment. The government also did not wait for the super soldiers to do their part, but formed special forces to continuously rescue the survivors. One day, a rescue signal arrived to them as they were simply trying to save people amidst the endless zombie attacks. The survivors were taking refuge in a temporary shelter amid the zombie attacks that had swarmed the city, and they were asking for rescue. Content. Will they be able to safely reach the temporary shelter where the survivors are holding out and rescue them?

summary.en: Cube (zs_cube) was an extra Zombie Scenario map in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
Cube (zs_cube) was an extra Zombie Scenario map in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

* This map was removed after Zombie Scenario Reboot.

Cube is a small survival-based map. It is separated into two sectors; with the same amount of players on each side. Zombies will spawn from four different locations.

This map is the only Zombie Scenario map where the players are divided into two teams and both teams have to battle while surviving. The players will be divided into Team Red & Team Blue while the objective of this map is to annihilate the rival team while surviving the onslaught of zombies. The team that has annihilated the rival team will win the round and that team will win the game once they have won three times.

There are items that are inclusive to this map only such as Bombs, Turrets and many more.

## Remove date

Cube was removed alongside Zombie Scenario Re:boot on:
 * South Korea: 28 January 2014.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 11 February 2014.
 * Japan: 12 February 2014.

## Trivia

* This is the first Zombie Scenario map that introduced Ganymede.
 * This is the only map that makes the player divided into two and battle each other.
 * Cube is unreleased in Singapore/Malaysia and Indonesia region for unknown reason.
 * This map was removed after Zombie Scenario Re:boot, making it the second removed map in Counter Strike Online, after City of Damned.

summary.en: Encounter (zs_encounter) is the first chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 4 in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
* 1) Gerard's sample recovery team, who survived the zombie chase, moves to the checkpoint where the red lizard luggage is in charge of the transport team.

Traces of some tissues were also found infected with the Rex virus, and judging from the destroyed large cage, Frozen Terror seems to have escaped the laboratory by running into a runaway as a result of continuous virus injection.

story.en:
* 1) Gerrard leaves Jim and acts independently to find traces of David Black.

 * 3) At the core facility of the research complex, you will meet several experimental sites and a man who introduces himself as Dr. Rex, the culprit of the Lost City incident.

It is not known what kind of experiment they went through, but they can often be seen competing and quarreling with each other as if they was trying to get one of themselves to recognize that who is stronger.

summary.en: Episode Carlito (zs_carlito) is the fourth and final chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 6 in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
* 1) Douglas Jacob first contacted me and gave me a mission, and the mission was to steal data from a research institute.
 * 2) The lab, where no one should be, had become a den of zombies, and traps were installed everywhere.
 * 3) They managed to steal the data and send it to Douglas, but Douglas said it was misinformation and ordered additional missions.
 * 4) While sending the radio to return to the headquarters after completing the additional mission safely, they receive an urgent rescue request from the headquarters.
 * 5) The Vanguard Company branch that Carlito belong to had already been destroyed by zombies, and he also tried to escape the Vanguard Company under Douglas Jacob's instructions.
 * 6) At a critical moment waiting for a rescue helicopter sent by Douglas, a helicopter that he thought was an ally, bombard at the remaining survivors indiscriminately, and this attack resulted on him losing one eye.
 * 7) It turns out that the enemy that attacked the Vanguard Company was none other than Douglas Jacob, and he had a decisive battle with Agent J, whom he sent.
 * 8) CF. During the attack of the helicopter that attacked the allies, the guided missile was able to intercept the air, reducing damage.
 * 9) CF. Judging from the conversation with Douglas, it seems that the Vanguard Company branch that Carlito was affiliated with was trying to destroy the Vanguard Company branch under the guise of a zombie attack so that the government did not find out about his link with the Vanguard Company.
 * 10) CF. No one knows Agent J real name, but she is Douglas' servant, and, judging from her abilities, she seems to be related to the Super Soldier Project that Douglas was working on.
 * 11) CF. In the final battle, Agent J could not be handled perfectly. She ran away alive, so if Carlito chases Douglas in the future, Agent J will stand in front of him once again.

story.en:

 * 9) CF. Chen self-interest drives him to buy and drive transport troops with his old friend Victor, resulting in the loss of one of his most important research materials, the Phobos' DNA. The Vanguard Company seems to be conducting experiment with the DNA somewhere.

summary.en: Forest Keeper (zs_multiboss) is the extra chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 6.

story.en:
Forest Keeper (zs_multiboss) is the extra chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 6.

## Overview

Correspondence in a virtual battle simulations of specific situations, the training is conducted under the subject of Dr. Evelyn.

## Objective

Destroy multiple mutant infected objects randomly appearing in virtual training locations and collect battle data.
 * Objective: Defeat all boss zombies.

## Tips

* Play the game through the guide information displayed on the map.
 * [E] is marked. If you press the E key at the place where the displayed device is activated.
 * You can destroy a structure that glows in red and proceed with the game.
 * After destroying the XT-300, you can capture it by pressing the [E] key and board it.

## Release date

* South Korea: 15 October 2020.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 21 October 2020.
 * China: 21 October 2020.
 * CSN:S: 11 November 2020.

## Transcripts

* Nice to meet you, brave combatants.
 * It is an honor to be in charge of conducting virtual battle simulations for combatants.
 * I am Evelyn from the National Security Agency.
 * Evelyn: Earlier, I would like to express my respect for the determination you have applied for this project.
 * Evelyn: This simulation is based on events from around the world...
 * Evelyn: ...by General Victor, Dr. Soi, Choi Ji Yoon, Jennifer, Jim and Gerard...
 * Evelyn: ...based on complex and vast data.
 * Evelyn: It is designed as a guide to tactical team-wide responses in context.
 * Evelyn: Each combatant's behavior data is analysed.
 * Evelyn: It will be a high example for the morale of the follow-up testers in the future.
 * Evelyn: Well, I wish you a meaningful and rewarding experience.
 * System: The next step will be opened upon achieving [Suppression of 2 main infectious agents] deployed in each zone

 * Wave 4-Enter Multi Boss Room 1
 * [Combat Protocol 1: Situation 1-14]
 * Tactical response to multiple mutant infected objects and operation of enemy equipment.

 * Wave 9-Enter Multi Boss Room 2
 * [Combat Protocol 2: Situation 2-37]
 * Quick judgment and replacement of infectious agents in complex behavior patterns.

 * Wave 11-Enter Multi Boss Room 3
 * [Combat Protocol 3: Situation 3-52]
 * Tactical position and effective history based on team unit by situation.

 * Wave 16-Enter Multi Boss Room 4
 * [Combat Protocol 4: Situation 4-29]
 * Securing escape routes and follow-up measures in unpredictable situations.

 * Wave 17-Arrival point
 * System: Basic Combat Protocol-Unfulfilled End Conditions
 * [Majority of Combatants Reunion] Required

 * Wave 18-Start of the final boss room
 * [Final Battle Protocol]
 * Analysis of threat patterns and acquisition of combat data of evolving infections.

## Event

* Receive the ultimate challenge, complete treasure!
 * Duration: 15-29 October 2020 (Korea)

Reach 180 scores from clearing Forest Keeper on different difficulties to get Dual Sword Hellfire with its Leather paint.
 * Hell: 6 points
 * Very hard: 4 points
 * Hard: 2 point
 * Normal/Easy: 0 point

 * Conditions
 * You must participate in the game for at least 10 minutes to accumulate the score.
 * You can participate in rooms of 4 or more people.
 * Up to 18 per day Score accumulation is possible.
 * Only one payment per account is given

## Trivia

* The loading background shows "Multiboss" which refers to multiple boss fights in the map. The players fight two bosses at a time, unlike Collapse, which is just one.
 * XT-300 Goliath is given in every boss fight for the players to kill and drive.
 * The map environment is similar to ancient relics and many Ghost Knights are seen.
 * The map skybox is Nebula, a space-themed skybox.
 * The simulated bosses and zombies have distorted appearance like a hologram, though with the lack of hologram effect.
 * All types of zombies, including the new ones, are seen in this map. However, they don't have any special skills and serve as regular zombies.
 * Despite being teased with Season 7 Bosses and Golden Angra in the Season 7 Preview, they are not seen in this map.
 * The hard-coded bosses, Bio Scorpion, Kraken, Gluttony, Crono Wing, Mr. X, Tyrant Crab and Agent Jay, are not seen.
 * Siege Type Dione does not have a death animation since it does not die in Sewer chapter, so it plays a dummy animation instead.

## Trivia

* Despite being the boss for Season 3, Kraken does not appear in Illusion, possibly due to how Illusion's arena is designed.

 * At the corners of this map, there are tables that can heal the players if they approach it. On these tables, there are some unusable Holy Bombs.
 * Although there is no sand in this map, Bio Scorpion can still dive and emerge from below the floor, with blue-colored dust instead of sand.
 * Jim and Victor appear as NPC guides even though they both did not appear in Zombie Scenario: Season 3 maps.
 * This map features some dynamic lights and moving clouds.
 * Fallen Titan drops only one supply box for each player, other bosses drop two.

story.en:
○○month ○○day △△hour △△minute

Anomaly signals began to be picked up in the Lost City, which was closed down due to a zombie apocalypse not long ago. A sudden stop in a forbidden place where civilian access is restricted. The signal that started to occur was suspicious. After identifying and interpreting the signal pattern, I was able to figure out a surprising fact. The signal was an encrypted communication, and its content was the one that put Gerard and David Black in a corner. It was about Super Soldier Agent B contacting Kronos. This information was reported to the superior immediately and they decided to continue monitoring their communications.
 * From the journal of an Aegis spy agent

summary.en: Last Clue (zs_lastclue) is the fourth Zombie Scenario map in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
* 1) The Counter-terrorism coalition, which received a request for rescue by the advance force, dispatched a rescue force, but the advance force had already been annihilated.
 * 2) The rescue team finds Andrei's notebook, the last clue left by the advance team in the middle of horrific corpse. A notebook that Andrei left while dying, it contains a lot of information about the Lost City incident. Since Dr. Rex's frantic mutterings were recorded on the roof of the last battle, it became information that could lead to Dr. Rex's laboratory.
 * 3) The rescue team moves to Dr. Rex's laboratory, which is the area marked in the notebook, in order to find even a little bit more traces of the advance force  Upon hearing that the rescue team is breaking into the lab, Dr. Rex hurriedly releases the Prototype Phobos and leaves the lab.
 * 4) After a fierce battle, the rescue team kills the prototype Phobos and obtains a corpse sample.
 * 5) CF. Prototype Phobos is the first named-type giant boss encountered. Even if it is a prototype, it is aiming for a perfect zombie that has removed all of its weaknesses, including hard skin, strong physical strength, speed and excellent combat sense formed through long term mutation.

summary.en: Last Ride (zs_lastride) or Last Flight is the final chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 5 in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
* 1) Jennifer travels by helicopter to Soi's base.
 * 2) While moving, they are being tracked by Kronos' reconnaissance drones.
 * 3) After a while, a mechanized monster that sent a reconnaissance drone appears.
 * 4) They shakes off Krono Wing, who has been tracking Jennifer and the others, but in the end, the helicopter is badly damaged and crashes.
 * 5) Jennifer's group, who crash-landed, attempts to go with Soi's to request HQ for rescue.
 * 6) Even the rescue request succeeded, but Krono Wing, who had shaken off earlier, was waiting for Jennifer and the others.
 * 7) Jennifer and Soi defeat Krono Wing and discover the identity of the third force that threatens the world is Kronos and Douglas Jacob.
 * 8) CF. Krono Wing was born as part of the mechanized Super Soldier project, like Kronobotics series. She is characterized by powerful ranged attacks while disturbing the enemy based on excellent mobility. She shows a strong loyalty to Douglas Jacob, and sometimes seems to have more than just loyalty.

Many factories and facilities were built due to industrialization, but many factories could not withstand the sudden recession and closed their doors. With its sparsely populated and adequate infrastructure, the Lost City was a suitable place for Dr. Rex to continue his research.

summary.en: Madness (zs_nightmare4) is the extra chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 4 in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
Madness (zs_nightmare4) is the extra chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 4 in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

The players are able to battle against the bosses from Zombie Scenario Season 4. The host must have the Madness key to open this chapter.

## Madness key

A powerful key can be acquired under certain conditions. If a player holds one, they will be sent to a temporary nightmare where strong creatures await.

When in possession, you are able to host the extra Zombie Scenario Season 4 chapter, Madness. This key will deplete upon usage.

## Goal

Defeat the zombie boss appeared in each round.

## Tips

* You can buy and upgrade weapons by pressing the key in the shop area.
 * Press the or  keys to recover stamina and  key to revive.
 * If your team has been annihilated, you can use the Round Retry item by pressing the key as long as you or someone possesses the item.
 * Surviving the round will result as money bonus. If not the case, you will receive a small amount as compensation, once your team has cleared the round.

## Bosses

Below is the list of the bosses and zombies in each round.

## Transcripts

* First Madness - Juggernaut

 * 1) Jim: Where am I?
 * 2) Jim: Here comes a huge guy, be ready! (After 55 seconds)

 * Second Madness - Frozen Wrath

 * 1) Jim: It is not over yet?
 * 2) Gerard: A strong zombie is coming! All ready! (After 55 seconds)

 * Third Madness - Savaging Gluttony
 * 1) Jim: What is this awful place? All hurry up and find the exit!
 * 2) Jim: What is that huge thing? It's coming here! (After 55 seconds)

 * Fourth Madness - Neid & Zavist

 * 1) Jim: What a strange dream... Why are you here again?
 * 2) ???: I'll crush you, silly!

 * Last Madness - Dr. Rex
 * 1) Jim: This is... Watch out for the traps in the room!
 * 2) Jim: That's really worse than the previous monsters, it's you again!

## Release date

Madness was released on:
 * South Korea: 6 November 2014.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 18 November 2014.
 * China/Japan: 19 November 2014.
 * Indonesia: 27 May 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 17 December 2015.

## Trivia

* Madness is a state of frenzied or chaotic activity.
 * Defeating bosses in this map does not increase the counter of [Wrath Controller], [Diet Controller], [Detective] and [Madness Terminator] medals.
 * Host zombies make no appearance in this map, only origin zombies appear, except the Sting Finger (only host Sting Finger appears, no origin one).
 * This is the first extra chapter which Ganymede does not appear as the main boss of Round 2.
 * This is the first extra chapter that bosses don't appear in one arena together. Each boss arena is based on the one of each chapter in Zombie Scenario: Season 4 (except Round 1 and 2 are the same).
 * In Taiwan/Hong Kong and Indonesia regions, there are few glitches such as sound looping or the fact that it is almost impossible to hit Frozen Terror when he's going to perform the Snowball Slam.
 * There is a mistake of showing NPC message during the cutscene in round 2, which the texts show Gerard, but the image message shows Jim.
 * There is a bug in round 1 which Juggernaut does not give any damage, only the zombies do so.

Jack, who has been living as a modified Super Soldier so far, informs her that he has a different power than Rex, and tries to kill Jennifer with a voluntary decision.

story.en:
Annihilation: Oblivion (zs_nightmare5) is the epilogue chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 5 in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

You can battle with the bosses of season 5 of the Zombie Scenario. Goal: Defeat the boss who appears every round.

## Oblivion Key

A key that exists only in forgotten memories. If you have this key, you may come back forgotten tonight. When you own this item, you can play Zombie Scenario Mode "Annihilation: Oblivion" map. This item is a Zombie Scenario item that you will be paid when you clear.

## Goal

Defeat the zombie boss appeared in each round.

## Tips

* Press 'B' in the store area to buy and upgrade weapons.
 * Press '5' or '6' keys to instantly replenish health.
 * If the team is wiped, you can use the Respawn item by pressing the R key.
 * You will receive more round clear bonuses.

## Bosses

Below is the list of the bosses and zombies in each map.

## Transcripts

* First Memory - [Laser Wing]
 * 1) Jennifer: Ah... My head... Where are we?
 * 2) Jennifer: Oh! You were not shot?
 * 3) I got a piece of memory about the Laser Wings.
 * 4) After a while, we move on to the next memory.
 * 5) Destroyed! Oblivion Round 1, clear!!

 * Second memory - [Jack]
 * 1) Jennifer: Ah... the headache is so bad.
 * 2) Jennifer: Jack?! What happened? Wake up!
 * 3) I got a piece of memory about Jack.
 * 4) After a while, we move on to the next memory.
 * 5) Destroyed! Oblivion Round 2, clear!!

 * The third memory - [Cronobotics]
 * 1) Jennifer: What is it? Why is it so strange?
 * 2) Jennifer: No! You! It must have been done with my own hand!
 * 3) I got a piece of memory about Chronobotics.
 * 4) After a while, we move on to the next memory.
 * 5) Destroyed! Oblivion Round 3, clear!!

 * Last Memory - [Crono Wing]
 * 1) Jennifer: Oh... I'm confused. Why am I doing this...?!
 * 2) Jennifer: It's a situation I've already experienced, why do I repeat it again?!
 * 3) I got a piece of memory about the Chrono Wing.
 * 4) A puzzle piece of all memorable memories was completed.
 * 5) Destroyed! Oblivion, All Round Clear!!

## Release date

* South Korea: 28 December 2017.
 * Indonesia: 10 January 2018.
 * CSNZ: 9 May 2018.

## Trivia

* The map loading background shows "Nightmare" instead of the real map name.
 * Among the epilogue series, this epilogue has four different maps and the players have to defeat four bosses only, instead of five.

story.en:
Alin and Dominique have destroyed the secret lab, ruining the hidden experiments kept inside. The powerful shockwave created by the destruction of its core has revealed the locations of Kronos' secret facilities, information which forced the governments of the world to launch detailed investigations. As the cover-up became known, former allies began to turn their backs on Douglas Jacob, who decided to take his wrath out on the world. By simultaneously attacking his most important enemies, he was able to convert their outposts for his own defense.

Due to Douglas Jacob's sudden ambush, the laboratories at the Aegis Institute were captured. In response, Jennifer and Dr. Soi have armed themselves, preparing to recapture the facilities.

summary.en: Poisoning (zs_nightmare2) or Addiction (for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies) is an extra Zombie Scenario: Season 2 map in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
Poisoning (zs_nightmare2) or Addiction (for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies) is an extra Zombie Scenario: Season 2 map in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

Eliminate every boss zombie which appears in every round. 60 seconds are given in every round to prepare the arrival of the boss. For the last boss, Angra, the player must escape to power plant's entrance after defeating it.

A map similar to Nightmare, the room host needs to have the Poisoning key to play this map. Instead of facing the bosses in Zombie Scenario: Season 1, the players will face the bosses from Zombie Scenario:Season 2.

## Events

Poisoning was released on:
 * South Korea: 12 August 2012.
 * China: 22 August 2012.
 * Singapore/Malaysia: 31 July 2013.
 * Indonesia: 31 July 2013.
 * Vietnam: 9 April 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 15 December 2015.

## Gameplay

There are 5 rounds in this map:

### Round 1/2

Kill zombies as many as possible to quickly level up health and attack power. Focus on these first before engaging the boss. Use any machine gun, equipment such as Black Dragon Cannon, AT4-CS, or M32 MGL, or any SKULL, BALROG or JANUS series weapon to clear the zombies and attack the boss.

It will be easier to upgrade the health and attack power to max level with the help of BALROG-I while there is only you in a room. Zombies will go in groups so it is easier to kill.

When engaging Juggernaut, beware of the traps set by Juggernaut and keep your distance.

When engaging Ganymede, players should stay back while 1 player distracts the boss.

### Round 3/4/5

* Anti-zombie weapons are recommended.
 * Grenades and launchers are needed too because there will be many zombies appearing within these three rounds.
 * Aim for the source that the zombies mainly come out of to delay their approach.
 * Always remember to buy Kevlar, Primary weapon ammo and upgrade Health and Attack.
 * Prioritize Health over Attack because the player would take a lot of damage in this map.
 * Use AT4-CS or Thunderbolt to defeat the Bosses quickly.

 * Round 4

## Trivia

* This map consists of various bosses that the player has met and fought from Zombie Scenario: Season 2, and it is even more terrifying than the previous bosses from Zombie Scenario, making the player to have their worst nightmare to fight them all over again.
 * Defeating bosses in this map doesn't increase the counter of [Dione Pursuer], [Fire Fighter] and [Last Soldier] medals.
 * Host zombies make no appearance in this map, only origin zombies appear, except the Sting Finger (only host Sting Finger appears, no origin one).
 * Siege Type Deimos is the former name for Ganymede, titled by Aegis Institute.
 * In Indonesia region, there is no Angra's location warning message even if the players have pressed the radio.
 * Also in Indonesia region, there is a bug where players cannot obtain Poisoning key after clearing any maps from Zombie Scenario: Season 2, making this map cannot be played again. This bug was fixed after the release of Illusion.

summary.en: Rex Labs (zs_biolabs), Missed Connections or Staggered Steps is the third chapter of Zombie Scenario Season 7 in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en: After escaping Panic Room, Erica, who was trying to control her body, began to periodically experience unexplained pain. David Black struggles to find the cause, but one day, when there is no way out, he was contacted by Soi. Soi heard news about Erica, and after seeing related information in the lab data, she told him to come to the Rex Labs if she wants to cure Erica. David Black and Erica set out for the Rex Lab after listening to it. But it wasn't Soi that greeted them, but a lab that seemed to have been attacked. Now they start searching the lab for any clues.

summary.en: ContactBGM Threat (zs_defense) is the third Zombie Scenario: Season 3 map in Counter-Strike Online.

story.en:
* 1) David Black's forces managed to enter the base, but suffered heavy losses in the battle against the Rusty Scorpion. In particular, when Erica is seriously injured during the battle, David decides that it is impossible to proceed further and settles down at the military factory facility inside the base and prepares the ranks.
 * 2) Norman, watching all this in a closed circuit, sends an armsuit to help them, but an Infected AMP Suit arrives and attacks David Black.
 * 3) The infected AMP ssuit kidnaps Erica and runs away, while David Black is puzzled by Norman's bizarre behavior and heads to the Vanguard Company's defense facility, the Panic Room.
 * 4) CF. Mad Mechanic is an infection of the Vanguard Company's AMP suit, and the original AMP suit was made for support rather than military purposes. Originally, it was equipped with a flamethrower and a small laser to secure an access route for cargo or soldiers, but after being infected with a virus, it is used to attack humans. As a model that has already been developed, many exist within the Vanguard Company.
 * 5) CF. It's unclear why Mad Mechanic kidnapped Erica, but David Black is convinced by his intuition that Erica has something special about her.

story.en: David Black and Erica decide to create a new team after hearing the truth from Gerard. They leave to find the person who demolished the Rex Labs in the past, agreeing to add them to the team. The clues lead them to a defunct munitions factory. David tries to enter the factory to see what's left inside, but as Erica's pain returns, they decide to lay low and get some rest. However, Douglas, who has been tracking the two, orders a group of hunters to finish them once and for all...
